typography.kinetic_large: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
typography.editorial_marquee: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-light font-['Outfit'] uppercase tracking-wide

spacing_system: Generous. Use py-24 to py-32 for section padding. gap-8 to gap-16 for grids.

visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Treat photos with a slight desaturation or duotone effect. Use crisp borders with 0px radius (sharp corners) to maintain the Swiss editorial feel.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Micro-interactions: Buttons translate up by 2px and cast a hard 4px solid shadow. Cards have borders that change from #E4E4E7 to #0038FF.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E4E4E7. Use grid lines to separate sections (border-t, border-b).

motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: Masked line-by-line text reveal (initial {y: '100%'}, animate {y: 0}, overflow-hidden container).
motion.marquee: react-fast-marquee for the 24/7 location ribbon, ultra-smooth, slow.
motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.parallax: Subtle framer-motion parallax on hero images (y offset linked to scroll).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white px-8 py-4 text-sm font-bold tracking-widest uppercase hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#09090B] transition-transform
buttons.whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] text-white px-8 py-4 text-sm font-bold tracking-widest uppercase hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#09090B] transition-transform flex items-center gap-2
buttons.emergency: bg-accent_danger text-white px-8 py-4 text-sm font-bold tracking-widest uppercase flex items-center gap-2 animate-pulse

cards.service: bg-surface border border-border p-8 hover:border-primary transition-colors flex flex-col justify-between group

forms.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-border py-4 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary transition-colors rounded-none w-full

layouts.header: Fixed, sticky, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px bottom border. Contains Logo, Nav links, Emergency Call CTA.
layouts.hero: High-impact kinetic typography. 'SPOEDKLUSSEN.' 'LOODGIETER & ELEKTRICIEN.' '24/7 BEREIKBAAR.' Side-by-side with abstract water/electric 3D visual or desaturated photo. Clear WhatsApp and Call CTAs.
layouts.marquee_locations: Full-width sliding text: '24/7 SPOEDDIENST - ZAVENTEM - DIEGEM - HAREN - SCHAERBEEK - ZUID - '
layouts.services_bento: Tetris grid layout (md:grid-cols-8 or 12). 7 services (loodgieterij spoed, elektriciteit, sanitair renovatie, verwarming, ontstopping, airco, laadpalen). Mix large spans and small squares.
layouts.werkwijze_manifesto: Numbered steps (01, 02, 03, 04) structured as a manifesto. Large typography '01 BEL ONS', '02 DIAGNOSE', etc.
layouts.before_after_gallery: Clipped image frames showing transformations. Use a slider or side-by-side hover reveal.
layouts.pricing_transparency: Minimalist table or text grid showing starting prices and 'Kennismakingsaanbieding' (introductory offer).
layouts.reviews: Editorial quotes. Large serif-like or elegant sans-serif quote text, author name below.
layouts.werkgebied_seo: A text-heavy but beautifully typeset section listing all regions served. Good for SEO.
layouts.lead_form: Minimalist form floating in a clean container, sharp edges. Name, Phone, Service, Message.
layouts.faq: Accordion list (Shadcn based but unstyled to look raw/editorial, border-b only).

hero_conceptual.description: Abstract water and electricity concept, use as Hero thematic visual.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page scrolling marketing site using Vite + React + Tailwind.
Strictly follow the 'Licht, clean, betrouwbaar' but highly editorial Awwwards aesthetic.
Install and use Lenis for smooth scrolling.
Install and use Framer Motion for scroll reveals and the kinetic hero.
Install and use react-fast-marquee for the location ribbon.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for layout sections (do not rely on Shadcn cards for the main structure, only use Shadcn for interactive logic like forms or accordions if needed).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g. py-24, py-32 for sections).
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
